change_summary: Introduce a separate research-only CBB availability missing-minutes efficiency fitter; pregame original source clocks, exact player/venue IDs, complete census, train-only ridge and untouched chronological holdout. No production or frozen v5 logic changes, no model promotion.
assumptions: Public GitHub holds synthetic fixtures and schema only; original licensed availability reports and full PIT training corpus are not yet independently admitted.
OUT/ACTIVE are the only eligible participation statuses; unknown/uncertain statuses fail closed until participation probabilities have their own independent fit.
An operator-supplied allowlist and SHA are shape/provenance claims, not independently authenticated source delivery.
No market price is allowed inside the projection schema, so market-close benchmark requires a separate evaluation pipeline.
Fitted coefficients and model improvement are not claimed unless exact real historical train/holdout corpus exists.
